test: 六个像素控制仿真任务；图 4 分开检验搜索与数据采集。真实动力学规划是对照，不是部署输入。
Six simulated pixel-control tasks; Fig. 4 separates search from data collection. Planning with true dynamics is a comparator, not a deployment input.

Player selects a latent action code

Spatiotemporal dynamics fills next-frame tokens given history and action
视觉解码器渲染画面供玩家观察
Visual decoder renders the frame for the player
将新 token 加入历史，等待下一动作

feedback: 回传的是生成世界的历史和玩家输入，不是外部传感器；训练时推断动作的网络不在游玩回路里。
Feedback is generated history plus player input, not an external sensor. The training-time action inference network is absent during play.
test: 平台游戏消融中，像素动作输入使 ΔPSNR 从 1.33 到 1.91，而 FVD 从 38.8 变为 40.1；记忆仅 16 帧，约每秒一帧。
On platformers pixel-input action inference raises ΔPSNR from 1.33 to 1.91 while FVD worsens from 38.8 to 40.1; memory is 16 frames and runtime about 1 FPS.
